name: Once Upon A Kiss
source:
Mary has been dreaming of finding her one true love ever since she was a kid. With her stepping up to take care of the farm, will she ever find one? And what do you mean there's a monster who can grant people wishes...

[From [url=https://difffy.itch.io/once-upon-a-kiss]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
玛丽从小就梦想着找到一位真爱。随着她开始打理农场，她能找到一个农场吗？还有什么意思，有一种怪物可以实现人们的愿望……

[来自[url=https://difffy.itch.io/once-upon-a-kiss]itch.io[/url]]
